parts.text:
Under the blight of the "Holy Soil phenomenon," ancient seals have loosened, and filth from the Ley Lines has surfaced once more.
Sheltered by the Narukami and united in the purification ritual, people call upon lightning to clear the filth and shared wishes to quell disaster, driving back the recurring evil time and time again.

#### Thunder Purges All Spite

**Resentment Within the Ley Lines:** Heh...

**Resentment Within the Ley Lines:** Haaah....

**Yukio:** Ah... Aaah!

**Hasegawa:** Wh—What the—

**Kuki Shinobu:** "God of Thunder, heed our call."

**Crowd:** "God of Thunder, heed our call—!"

**Sangonomiya Kokomi:** "Foul powers, disperse, be silenced once and for all."

**Crowd:** "Foul powers, disperse, be silenced once and for all."

**Yae Miko:** "With your might, let illusions fall!"

**Crowd:** "With your might, let illusions fall—!"

**Yae Miko:** ...It's done. The corruption has been purged.

**Ginkaku:** For now. If only it wasn't temporary...

**Kinkaku:** Mm! Stupid Ginkaku! Now's not the time for depressing talk! We'll purge it all, you'll see!

**Yae Miko:** Heh, Ginkaku is right, I'm afraid. This won't be enough by itself.

**Sangonomiya Kokomi:** The spread of the Hallowing has destroyed many of the seals left behind by our predecessors. As long as it persists, we will never see true peace.

**Kuki Shinobu:** Then, until we've resolved all the "trials," our only option is to exorcise these guys every time they show up.

**Tetsunosuke:** They're gonna keep coming? Mmm... I... I wanna go back to Chinju Forest...

**Kinkaku:** Tetsunosuke! No running away!

**Tetsunosuke:** Go bring our nest over here, then!

**Yae Miko:** Hehe...

**Yae Miko:** (The "greater disaster" has arrived... but this time, the hopes of the people stand with you.)
